mapper.update: UPDATE salary SET month=#{month}, basic_salary=#{basicSalary}, food_subsidy=#{foodSubsidy}, traffic_subsidy=#{trafficSubsidy}, housing_subsidy=#{housingSubsidy}, level_subsidy=#{levelSubsidy}, late_fine=#{lateFine}, tax=#{tax}, actual_salary=#{actualSalary} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, e.name AS name, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM salary s LEFT JOIN employee e ON s.emp_id = e.id LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
